facts.fact: Eswatini's ICT ministry launched the Government-In-Your-Hand app in May 2025, offering document status checks, business registration, education services and utility payments, with no count of services given.

The Government-In-Your-Hand app carries services of several bodies (ID and passport status, business registration, education loans, utility payments), with sign-up by national ID and an SMS one-time code, per Eswatini Positive News.
An ICT ministry engineer said the Government-In-Your-Hand app had over 2,000 downloads in its first month, and that over 200 people had it on their phones.
